values: Select the appropriate data worksheet in the import workspace. Import one worksheet at a time.
Replace the example rows before using this workbook. IDs such as 1 are placeholders, not confirmed record IDs.
Confirm suggested matches, fill required fields, and use fixed values for shared local IDs where appropriate.
Review all validation errors, cleaning suggestions and duplicate decisions. Correct values or return to mapping.
Default: skip existing records. Supported master records can be updated. Transactions cannot be overwritten.
Review the preview and confirm import. Import history records results and provides revoke / remap options.
Undo is blocked if imported records were later edited or have dependent records. No partial revoke is performed.
Connect QuickBooks Online or Zoho Books after administrator OAuth setup; fetched data goes through the same mapping and preview.
Outstanding bills must use the company base currency. No automatic currency conversion or journal posting.
CTC is annual; Basic and HRA are monthly. Salary assignments are imported, not processed payslips.
See the field guide below. Empty optional sample cells may remain blank. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD.
name, pipeline_id, stage_id, amount — Import open deals; choose an existing pipeline and stage.
movement_number, product_id, warehouse_id, movement_date, quantity_in, rate — Opening stock updates warehouse balances. Updates to existing movements are blocked; revoke before correcting.
order_number, title, customer_id, total_amount — Orders are imported as drafts for review; importing never confirms or issues stock.
employee_id, first_name, last_name, date_of_joining — Employee records only; no login accounts or invitations are created.
employee_code, effective_from, ctc — Imports salary assignments, not processed payslips. CTC is annual; Basic and HRA are monthly. Overlapping salary assignments are rejected.
project_id, log_date, duration_minutes, description — Time entries belong to the importing user and remain pending approval.
ledger_code, ledger_name, ledger_group_id, nature — Opening values are imported master values; review opening balance posting separately. No journals are posted.

party_id, ledger_id, bill_number, bill_date, due_date, bill_type, currency, original_amount, outstanding_amount — Imports opening bill references for matching and collection; does not post accounting vouchers.
statement_id, transaction_date, description, reference_number — Choose an existing statement. Imported lines remain unmatched until reviewed.
